firewall_rules.name: Block Suspicious User Agents
firewall_rules.expression: (http.user_agent contains "bot" or http.user_agent contains "crawler" or http.user_agent contains "scraper" or http.user_agent contains "python" or http.user_agent contains "curl" or http.user_agent contains "wget") and not (http.user_agent contains "Googlebot" or http.user_agent contains "Bingbot" or http.user_agent contains "Slurp") and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/"
firewall_rules.description: Block known bot user agents from API endpoints (except legitimate search engines)

firewall_rules.name: Block Requests Without User-Agent
firewall_rules.expression: not http.user_agent exists and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/"
firewall_rules.description: Block API requests without User-Agent header

firewall_rules.name: Rate Limit API Endpoints
firewall_rules.expression: http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/" and (cf.threat_score gt 20 or cf.bot_management.score lt 30)
firewall_rules.description: Challenge requests with high threat score or low bot score on API endpoints

firewall_rules.name: Block High Threat Score IPs
firewall_rules.description: Block IPs with very high threat scores from API

firewall_rules.name: Block Known Bad Countries
firewall_rules.description: Block specific countries from API (adjust country codes as needed)

firewall_rules.name: Block Suspicious Request Patterns
firewall_rules.expression: (http.request.uri.query contains "union" or http.request.uri.query contains "select" or http.request.uri.query contains "script" or http.request.uri.query contains "<script") and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/"
firewall_rules.description: Challenge requests with SQL injection or XSS patterns in query strings

firewall_rules.name: Block Invalid HTTP Methods
firewall_rules.expression: not http.request.method in {"GET" "POST" "PUT" "DELETE" "OPTIONS"} and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/"
firewall_rules.description: Block non-standard HTTP methods on API endpoints

firewall_rules.name: Block Requests with Suspicious Headers
firewall_rules.expression: (http.request.headers["X-Forwarded-For"] contains "," or http.request.headers["X-Real-IP"] contains ",") and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/"
firewall_rules.description: Challenge requests with multiple IPs in forwarded headers (possible proxy abuse)

firewall_rules.name: Block Empty or Malformed Authorization
firewall_rules.expression: (http.request.headers["Authorization"] eq "" or not http.request.headers["Authorization"] contains "Bearer ") and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/auth/"
firewall_rules.description: Challenge auth endpoints with empty or malformed Authorization headers

firewall_rules.name: Geo-blocking for Auth Endpoints
firewall_rules.expression: ip.geoip.country ne "US" and ip.geoip.country ne "CA" and ip.geoip.country ne "GB" and http.request.uri.path starts_with "/api/auth/"
firewall_rules.description: Block auth endpoints from non-allowed countries (adjust countries as needed)

ip_access_rules.name: Whitelist Trusted IPs
ip_access_rules.notes: Add your office/VPN IP ranges here

ip_access_rules.name: Blacklist Known Bad IPs
ip_access_rules.notes: Add known malicious IP ranges here

notes: These rules should be configured in Cloudflare Dashboard → Security → WAF
Rate limit rules require Cloudflare Pro plan or higher
IP access rules can be managed via Cloudflare API or Dashboard
Adjust country codes, threat scores, and thresholds based on your traffic patterns
Test rules in 'Log' mode before enabling 'Block' or 'Challenge' actions
